title: Opus decomposition pass over zephyr/c open beads
description: The zephyr/c pool (~106 open beads) is too coarse for the Yegge 5-minute swarm protocol — these were the multi-hour grinds. Run an Opus pass (anthropic/claude-4-5 class) that, for each open bead labeled zephyr or c (excluding blocked:hardware, owner-reserved, defer-external): (1) assesses complexity; (2) if >5 minutes of complexity, decomposes into children via bd create --parent <id> --label zephyr,decomposed — each child ONE narrow change (≤20 lines, 1-2 files), as many children as the work needs; (3) beads touching oscore/EDHOC internals or security semantics: do NOT decompose — label human-only for Mark; (4) hardware-dependent beads: label blocked:hardware; (5) adds the fine-grained area label (hal, lr1110, tdma, l2, board name) for affinity routing. Run in batches of ~10-15 beads per opencode run to keep sessions bounded. Estimate: ~0-100 total Opus spend. Output: before/after counts + list of human-only beads. Do not touch oscore source; this pass only creates/tags beads.
close_reason: Decomposition pass complete. See session report.
